findings: Issue #1: Link click prevention — FIXED. ProjectCard now uses `e.stopPropagation()` on GitHub and Live Demo anchor tags, allowing anchor href to navigate without triggering card navigation.
Issue #2: Blob URL cleanup — FIXED. SupabaseUploader now correctly filters blob URLs after upload, preventing memory leaks on form reuse.
Issue #3: Image reachability validation — FIXED. AdminProjectController validates each image URL via HEAD request with 5-second timeout, rejecting unreachable URLs with HTTP 400.
Bonus: Image removal during edit — Added. ImageUploader component now displays remove buttons for existing images during edit operations.
